title: Kicky Indulgent Vietnamese Guanciale Bo Kho
description: A rich and savory Vietnamese bo kho dish featuring guanciale and double-fry KFC, made shojin-friendly by using plant-based alternatives.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat and cook the guanciale until crispy.
Remove the guanciale from the pot and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the onions to the pot and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the carrots to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the star anise and cinnamon sticks to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fish sauce, soy sauce, and tomato paste to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer.
Add the vegetarian chicken strips to the pot and cook until they are fully coated in the sauce.
Return the guanciale to the pot and stir to combine.
Simmer the bo kho for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
